# `oaap metrics`

node history of CPU, memory and disk (RFC-0051).

**Root:** depends on the action -- see the table below.

## Usage

```sh
oaap metrics {sample,show,queue,queue-purge,sender} [{set,show,test,remove}] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `sender_action` | for 'sender' (one of `set`, `show`, `test`, `remove`) |
| `--url URL` | for 'sender set': mqtts://host[:port] |
| `--user USER` | for 'sender set' |
| `--node NODE` | for 'sender set': this node's name on the wire (default: the host name) |
| `--root ROOT` | for 'sender set': topic root (default oaap-node) |
| `--ca CA` | for 'sender set': a private CA file |
| `--allow-plain` | for 'sender set': allow mqtt:// to a private address |
| `--yes` | for 'queue-purge': really delete |
| `--window WINDOW` | for 'show': 4h, 24h (default), 1w or 1m |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `sample` | yes |
| `show` | no |
| `queue` | no |
| `queue-purge` | yes |
| `sender` | yes |
